options_evaluated: Glass-fiber reinforced polyamide (PA6-GF30) with overmolded TPU grips
Monolithic high-impact polycarbonate (PC) shell with mechanically fastened elastomer grips
assessments.recommendation: Monolithic high-impact polycarbonate (PC) shell with mechanically fastened elastomer grips
assessments.rationale: This option maximizes durability and reliability under physical stress (a) [Page 79] and prevents premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27] caused by grip degradation. Overmolded TPU grips are prone to abrasive wear, releasing microplastics and nanoplastics (p) [Page 80] during use, and cannot be repaired. In contrast, mechanically fastened grips support ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79], allowing independent replacement and reducing the amount of waste generated (r) [Page 80] during the operational phase.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (increased assembly complexity and part count) and End-of-Life (requires manual disassembly of different materials for recycling).

options_evaluated: Threaded metal inserts with standard Torx screws
assessments.recommendation: Threaded metal inserts with standard Torx screws
assessments.rationale: Threaded metal inserts with standard Torx screws ensure ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] by utilizing standard components and ensuring compatibility with commonly available tools [Page 8]. This allows non-destructive disassembly to replace worn internal parts, preventing premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27] and minimizing waste generated (r) [Page 80] compared to welded or glued housings which must be discarded if an internal component fails.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (higher production costs and longer assembly times) and End-of-Life (requires manual disassembly to separate metal inserts from plastic).

options_evaluated: Brushed DC motor with integrated gearbox
Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with modular planetary gearbox
assessments.recommendation: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with modular planetary gearbox
assessments.rationale: A BLDC motor eliminates brush wear, significantly extending the technical lifetime and reliability (a) [Page 79] of the tool. The modular planetary gearbox supports ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] by allowing independent replacement of the gear assembly or motor. This reduces energy consumption in service (g) [Page 3] and lowers the environmental footprint (m) [Page 79] while maintaining high functional performance (s) [Page 80].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Sourcing (requires critical raw materials for magnets) and Manufacturing (higher cost of electronic controllers).

options_evaluated: Active cooling with an internal fan and dust-filtered vents
Closed-loop heat pipe with external aluminum heatsink fins
assessments.recommendation: Closed-loop heat pipe with external aluminum heatsink fins
assessments.rationale: A closed-loop system prevents dust, debris, and moisture from entering the housing during operation, protecting internal electronics and gears to ensure durability and reliability (a) [Page 79]. Open vents expose components to abrasive particles, degrading functional performance (s) [Page 80] and causing premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27]. This closed-loop approach maintains optimal conditions for use (s) [Page 80] without requiring regular filter cleaning or replacement, reducing maintenance needs (b) [Page 79].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (higher thermal component cost and increased weight) and Sourcing (increased material footprint of copper and aluminum).

options_evaluated: Fully integrated single-board design (motor, switch, and BMS on one PCB)
Highly modular architecture with plug-and-play connections for battery, switch, BMS, and motor
Semi-modular architecture with soldered wire connections
assessments.recommendation: Highly modular architecture with plug-and-play connections for battery, switch, BMS, and motor
assessments.rationale: This architecture directly enhances ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] by allowing professional repairers or users [Page 29] to replace individual faulty sub-assemblies without specialized soldering skills (s) [Page 80]. It ensures the availability and accessibility of spare parts (l) [Page 79] for specific high-wear components (like switches), preventing premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27] and reducing the generation of hazardous electronic waste (r) [Page 80].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (increased internal space requirements, higher connector costs, and complex routing) and Sourcing (increased material footprint from extra connectors).

options_evaluated: Removable and interchangeable slide-on Li-ion battery pack with standardized interface
Corded AC power supply with transformer
assessments.recommendation: Removable and interchangeable slide-on Li-ion battery pack with standardized interface
assessments.rationale: Batteries are high-wear consumables. A removable slide-on pack ensures ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] and the availability of consumables and spare parts (l) [Page 79]. Standardized interfaces facilitate interoperability (l) [Page 79], allowing users to share batteries across tools, which reduces the environmental footprint (m) [Page 79] and waste generated (r) [Page 80] while maintaining cordless functional performance and conditions for use (s) [Page 80].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Design/Aesthetics (creates a bulkier, heavier tool) and Manufacturing (requires robust contact interfaces and latch mechanisms).
